title: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each qualifying admin
question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each qualifying administratively up port that is both bound to a security group and has at least one IP allocation, return the port ID, tenant ID, port name, MAC address, the number of security group bindings, the total number of DNS records on the port, the number of IP allocations, the total number of subnet-id rows from those allocations, along with the average number of IP allocations per qualifying port for that tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH qualifying_ports AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.name AS port_name,
    p.mac_address,
    COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count,
    COUNT(pd.port_id) AS dns_record_count,
    COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON p.id = sgpb.port_id
  LEFT JOIN portdnses pd ON p.id = pd.port_id
  JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
    AND p.admin_state_up = 1
    AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name, p.mac_address
  HAVING COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(ia.ip_address) >= 1
),
avg_ip_allocations AS (
  SELECT AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations
  FROM qualifying_ports
)
